releaseNotes:
• Duty-Date Color UI: Blue theme when duty date is Today/Live, Green theme when duty date is Tomorrow, and Greyish theme when No Duty is assigned!
• Bottom-Aligned Widget Card & Fixed Carousel Buttons: Card stays anchored to the bottom leaving empty top expansion room so '◀ / MAIN / #1–#5 / ▶' never jump vertically when switching between Active Duty and Off Duty!
• Vivo Funtouch OS (rev 1.73.3) & Android 5–14 Installer Compatibility Fix (PNG launcher icons, clean ZIP headers, API 21–34 support)
